e17687c2f8edb82e.description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Analyst who is sharp, curious, and thrives on turning raw numbers into clear product decisions. You will sit at the heart of our Product team, working across one or more of our six apps to uncover insights hiding in behavioural data, funnels, and cohorts. This is a high-visibility role for someone who has already built a strong analytical foundation and is ready to independently drive the data narrative behind major product bets. You will partner closely with Product Managers, Design, Engineering, and Growth teams, and your analysis will directly shape features used by millions of people every day.

Responsibilities

• Analyse user behaviour, engagement metrics, funnels, and retention cohorts to surface actionable insights.
• Build and maintain dashboards (SQL, Metabase, Amplitude, or similar tools) to track product and business KPIs.
• Translate complex datasets into clear, digestible insights for Product, Design, and Leadership teams.
• Proactively flag anomalies, trends, and opportunities across the user lifecycle.
• Design, run, and analyse A/B experiments in partnership with Product Managers.
• Define success metrics and guardrail metrics for new feature launches.
• Build hypotheses backed by data and help prioritise the product roadmap.
• Conduct pre- and post-launch impact analysis for shipped features.
• Own weekly and monthly performance reporting across charter apps.
• Prepare data-backed presentations for leadership and Co-Founder reviews.
• Partner with Data Science and Analytics teams on predictive models and personalisation efforts.
• Support PRDs and product specs with relevant data context and sizing.
• Assist in user research, surveys, and usability studies to understand user segments.
• Track competitive and market trends across live streaming, social gaming, and creator economy platforms.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in product analytics, business analytics, or a similar data-focused role.
• Strong proficiency in SQL and comfort working with large datasets.
• Experience with dashboarding and visualisation tools such as Metabase, Amplitude, or Tableau.
• Solid grasp of funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B testing fundamentals.
• Excellent communication skills, able to translate data into a clear narrative for non-technical stakeholders.
• High ownership mindset with a track record of independently driving analysis for high-stakes product decisions.
• Experience with Python or R for deeper statistical analysis.
• Exposure to consumer apps with large user bases (1M+ DAU).
• Familiarity with Mixpanel, Clevertap, or Firebase.
• Prior experience in social entertainment, gaming, or creator economy platforms.
• Experience at a high-growth startup (Series A-C stage).
• Experience mentoring junior analysts or leading analytics for a product charter independently.

This job was posted by Aparna Majumder from Tamasha.

e1f894aa8e7dd9a8.description:
Senior GenAI / LLM Engineer
Experience: 6+ Years
Location: Bangalore
Work Mode: Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-time
About the Role

CoffeeBeans is looking for a Senior GenAI / LLM Engineer to build and optimize production-grade Generative AI applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience across LLM application development, prompt optimization, evaluation, guardrails, and observability.

What You'll Do
• Build and optimize LLM/GenAI applications for real-world business use cases.
• Design and improve prompts for accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
• Create LLM evaluations (evals) to measure response quality, relevance, groundedness, and performance.
• Design and implement custom guardrails for domain-specific AI applications, beyond basic prompt instructions.
• Debug and improve LLM applications using LangSmith, MLflow, or similar observability tools.
• Build and optimize RAG pipelines, including retrieval and context strategies.
• Work with LLM frameworks and APIs to develop scalable AI solutions.
• Collaborate with engineering, product, and business teams to take AI solutions from POC to production.
Must Have
• 6+ years of software/AI/ML engineering experience.
• Strong Python development experience.
• Hands-on experience building GenAI/LLM applications.
• Strong experience with Prompt Engineering / Prompt Optimization.
• Experience writing and implementing LLM evals.
• Experience building custom AI/LLM guardrails.
• Hands-on experience with LangSmith, MLflow, or similar tools for LLM debugging/observability.
• Experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.
• Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent.
• Experience working with LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, or open-source models.
Good to Have
• Experience with AI Agents / Agentic AI.
• Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol).
• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.
• Understanding of LLM security concepts such as prompt injection and hallucination prevention.
What We're Looking For
Someone who has hands-on experience building, evaluating, debugging, and improving real-world LLM applications—not just experimenting with prompts or ChatGPT.
If you're excited about building reliable, production-ready GenAI solutions, we'd love to hear from you!
